title: small silicone type containers
text: small silicone type containers. purchased these to put finger snacks in for my grandsons (5 and 8) in the car or on the plane... they are easy to open (just pinch) and yet keep things inside when laying down.  I put them in the dishwasher (top rack) and they did great.  Now.  If I can keep them out of my husbands hands for his shop items, it will be good.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
